description.zh:
需要查询秒级监控信息的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~27584~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where you want to query the configuration of fine-grained monitoring.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 日志标签。其结构是一个JSON dictionary，包含标签键和标签值。
description.en: The tags of the logs. The tags must be key-value pairs that are contained in a JSON dictionary.

title.zh: 查询实例业务运行监控数据

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-high-defination-monitor --tags tagKey_:_Key1_,_tagValue_:_Value1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
